title: Adaptive reuse

captions.instagram:
What if some of the best new homes are inside old offices?

Adaptive reuse gives an existing building a new purpose, often turning older commercial, office or hotel buildings into residential. In dense cities, the structure and the location are already there.

Save the 5 questions I'd ask before a conversion.

captions.facebook:
Old office, new home. I put together how adaptive reuse works and five questions to ask before converting a building.

#AdaptiveReuse #RealEstate

Is there an empty building near you that should become homes?
captions.linkedin:
The greenest building is often the one that's already standing.

Adaptive reuse gives an existing property a new purpose: office, commercial or hotel buildings turned into residential. In dense cities, the structure and the location already exist; the question is whether the building can work for its new job.

Building new starts from an empty site. Converting starts from what's sound and works within it.

Five questions I'd ask before a conversion: What does zoning allow? What condition is the building in? Is the location in demand? What will it cost? Who will live there?

#AdaptiveReuse #RealEstate

Which question decides most conversions?
